title: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. translated_title: PriorityFEC：面向边缘多智能体系统中KV缓存交接的截止时间感知流式前向纠错
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统越来越多地部署在边缘环境中，以支持需要多个智能体之间协作与信息交换的复杂任务。然而，当任务上下文在智能体之间传递时，已被上游智能体处理过的共享上下文往往需要重新进行预填充，从而导致大量冗余计算。复用已经预填充的键值（KV）缓存可以避免这种重复计算，但需要在接收智能体开始生成之前，将可复用的KV状态通过网络进行传输。在严格的首字延迟（TTFT）截止时间和不可靠的边缘链路条件下，完整传输KV缓存可能是不可行的，因此有必要在有限的传输预算内对最有价值的KV信息进行优先级排序和保护。本文提出了PriorityFEC，一种效用感知的KV缓存交接方案，它联合利用模型侧的KV重
tldr: 提出PriorityFEC，一种效用感知的KV缓存交接方案，在边缘多智能体LLM系统中，通过截止时间感知的流式前向纠错，在有限传输预算内优先保护最有价值的KV信息，以满足首字延迟要求并避免冗余的预填充计算。
en_tdlr: PriorityFEC is a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that uses deadline-aware streaming FEC to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget, enabling timely KV-cache reuse across agents in edge multi-agent LLM systems under strict TTFT deadlines and unreliable links.
